original_title: Phony whistleblowers, fake journalists and cyber spies: ICIJ network targeted after China Targets probe

ai_analysis.detailed_analysis: The ICIJ network has been targeted by phony whistleblowers, fake journalists, and cyber spies after the China Targets probe. This indicates a high level of sophistication and resources being used to compromise the security of investigative journalists.
ai_analysis.immediate_forecast_24h: Increased cyber attacks and phishing attempts on journalists and media outlets are expected in the next 24 hours.
ai_analysis.strategic_outlook: The use of cyber spies and fake journalists poses a long-term threat to the security of media outlets and investigative journalists, potentially compromising their ability to conduct thorough investigations.
ai_analysis.operational_impact: The targeting of the ICIJ network may impact the ability of journalists to securely communicate and share information, potentially disrupting the logistics of investigative reporting.
